name: @acrinym/continuity-bridge
description: Local-first AI continuity bridge with ChatGPT and Claude imports, Lore MCP setup, and resumable conversation delivery without API credits.
author: Justin Gargano

scripts.check: node --check bin/continuity-bridge.js && node --check src/cli.js && node --check src/incremental/manifest.js && node --test
scripts.smoke: node bin/continuity-bridge.js import-chatgpt test/fixtures/chatgpt-export --dry-run && node bin/continuity-bridge.js import-claude test/fixtures/claude-export --dry-run
scripts.check:desktop: python -m py_compile desktop/continuity_bridge_desktop/client.py desktop/continuity_bridge_desktop/app.py desktop/continuity_bridge_desktop/mcp_control.py desktop/continuity_bridge_desktop/control_center.py desktop/continuity_bridge_gui.py && python -m unittest discover -s desktop/tests -v
